variants.prompt: Bathed in the warm, soft glow of flickering candles, the ravishing French beauty reclines in a lavish, velvet-upholstered armchair. A sheer, silk robe drapes loosely over her porcelain skin, parted to reveal the tantalizing curves of a lace bra and matching panties. Honey-blonde waves spill over one shoulder, and emerald eyes gleam with a playful, teasing light. The camera captures her in an extreme close-up, with the shallow depth of field blurring the candlelit background into a warm, golden haze. Delicate gold jewelry sparkles in the candlelight.
